Orca: Progressive Learning from Complex Explanation Traces of GPT-4 Paper Reading
Introduction
Recent research focuses on improving smaller models through imitation learning using outputs from large foundation models (LFMs). Challenges include limited imitation signals, homogeneous training data, and a lack of rigorous evaluation, leading to overestimation of small model capabilities. To address this, we introduce Orca, a 13-billion parameter model that learns to imitate LFMs’ reasoning process.
